research_mode: official HMICFRS sources only; PEEL 2025-2027 scope, cycle and interpretation controls; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: PEEL force coverage
verified_claims: PEEL assesses all 43 police forces in England and Wales
limitations: PEEL coverage is force-level, not parcel-level

sources.name: PEEL effectiveness dimension
limitations: effectiveness is an inspection judgement, not a crime-rate measure

sources.name: PEEL efficiency dimension
limitations: efficiency must not be converted into local safety scores

sources.name: PEEL legitimacy dimension
limitations: legitimacy findings are not incident counts

sources.name: Cycle-specific PEEL questions
verified_claims: assessment questions do not remain identical for every inspection cycle
limitations: grades across cycles require framework-version checks

sources.name: PEEL priority adaptation
verified_claims: PEEL questions adapt to changing policing priorities and circumstances
limitations: question changes can create comparability breaks

sources.name: Latest force grades
verified_claims: the PEEL assessments service presents the latest grades for each force
limitations: latest grades must be tied to report date and cycle

sources.name: Latest force report
verified_claims: users can open each force's latest PEEL report
limitations: summary grades do not replace the underlying report findings

sources.name: Previous PEEL reports
verified_claims: previous force reports and related information remain available
limitations: historical reports use their own cycle framework

sources.name: PEEL 2025-2027 methodology
verified_claims: HMICFRS provides methodology information for the 2025-2027 cycle
limitations: methodology context is required before using cycle grades

sources.name: PEEL 2025-2027 reported questions
verified_claims: HMICFRS identifies the questions reported on in the 2025-2027 cycle
limitations: question-level coverage must not be assumed from earlier cycles

sources.name: PEEL cycle changes
verified_claims: HMICFRS documents changes from the previous PEEL cycle
limitations: trend interpretation requires reading those changes

sources.name: Custody inspection inclusion
verified_claims: the 2025-2027 cycle includes information on police custody inspection activity
limitations: custody inspection findings are not general crime outcomes

sources.name: Fraud inspection inclusion
verified_claims: the 2025-2027 cycle includes information on fraud inspection activity
limitations: fraud inspection scope must not be extrapolated to all force activity

sources.name: PEEL national spotlights
verified_claims: HMICFRS publishes national reports and thematic spotlights arising from PEEL work
limitations: national themes do not provide parcel-level observations
